status_definitions.COMPLETE: Every required curriculum skill has identifiable source teaching, activity/investigation and aligned assessment evidence. This is resource coverage, not pupil mastery, full media approval or live-service certification.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Relevant implemented resources exist, but one or more required skills, assessed reasoning forms or assessment-validity requirements have a concrete gap.
status_definitions.MISSING: No implemented resources establish this descriptor.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Potential coverage exists but cannot be established from inspected evidence. Never counted complete.

release_gate: A strand is complete for onward development only when all descriptor coverage is COMPLETE, all applicable QA passes, final media has required exact-file approval, and deployment including authorised service checks is verified. Content coverage counts alone cannot open this gate.

service_verification.details: No live Firebase sign-in, deployed rules/App Check, real protected callable success or cross-device progress is established by public retrieval or safe SDK mocks. Existing security and service paths remain unchanged.

descriptors.title: Decimal place value
descriptors.description: interpret, compare and order numbers with more than 2 decimal places, including numbers greater than one, using place value understanding; represent these on a number line
required_knowledge_and_skills: Interpret digit values through thousandths, including values above one
Compare/order unequal decimal lengths using placeholder zeros
Represent decimals on a number line

assessment.finding: Decimal questions use >2 places and values above one, ordering and number-line positions.

corrective_action: Remove within-attempt repeated decimal questions in Whole Numbers and Decimals & Percentages and validate uniqueness across bands. The deterministic 1,000-attempt audit found 1,340 duplicate positions in Whole Numbers (all 1,000 attempts) and 1,013 in Decimals & Percentages (700 attempts); fixed decimal prompts recur unchanged.

skill_evidence.requirement: Interpret digit values through thousandths, including values above one
Compare/order unequal decimal lengths using placeholder zeros
Represent decimals on a number line
